intent.product_service_or_topic: SocialGenius Content Studio, a tool that helps small businesses turn a reference video's structure into their own short, editable social video
intent.target_audience: small-business owners who post on social media but have little time or video experience
intent.objective: make the audience curious enough to try the tool for their next post
intent.desired_cta: Try it for your next post
mandatory_points: show that the video stays editable after it is built
prohibited_claims_or_elements: claims about what viewers will do

blueprint.intent_summary: Topic: SocialGenius Content Studio, a tool that helps small businesses turn a reference video's structure into their own short, editable social video. Audience: small-business owners who post on social media but have little time or video experience. Objective: make the audience curious enough to try the tool for their next post. Business: SocialGenius. Format: Instagram Reels, 12s.
blueprint.structural_approach: Four short beats on Instagram Reels: open on the tool itself with a hint of imminent use, show a quick before/after demonstration proving the output stays editable, then close on a warm human-facing moment that invites trying it on the next post.

mechanism_dispositions.application_rationale: Section 1 opens on a clean, centered shot of the app interface with a small gesture (finger about to tap) suggesting imminent use, rather than narration or action first.
mechanism_dispositions.transferable_principle: Open on a clean, centered shot of the product itself with a small human gesture suggesting imminent use, rather than starting with action or narration.

mechanism_dispositions.application_rationale: Sections 2-3 hold the same draft video constant and sequence a close-up of its raw structure then a shot of it rebuilt and still editable, implying quality and payoff before a spokesperson appears.
mechanism_dispositions.transferable_principle: Sequence close-up shots of material texture followed by a shot of the product in use with sensory cues (steam, light) to imply quality and payoff before introducing a spokesperson.

mechanism_dispositions.application_rationale: Section 4 closes with a warm human presence facing camera to shift from screen-focused demonstration to a personal, trust-oriented tone carrying the call to action.
mechanism_dispositions.transferable_principle: Close a product-focused sequence with a warm human presence facing the camera to transition from object-centered demonstration to a personal, trust-oriented tone.

prohibited_claims_or_elements: claims about what viewers will do

do_not_reproduce.description: Specific jar branding and packaging text shown in the opening shot.
Garbled, unverified spoken claim accompanying the opening.
Ginger-garlic paste as the specific product category and cooking context.
Specific steam and pan imagery used to signal cooking.
Specific appearance, dress, and setting of the closing presenter.

constraints.copy_policy: Instructions only. This blueprint contains no final hook lines, captions, scripts, headlines, CTA wording or voiceover copy; those are produced downstream from these instructions.
constraints.performance_policy: Structural design logic is transferred; no performance, engagement, retention or conversion outcome is claimed or implied.

sections.section_purpose: Establish the product as the visual subject and create curiosity about what it will do.
sections.content_instruction: Show the app open on a phone screen, centered, with a hand poised to tap a button that will start building a video from a reference clip.
required_information: to be supplied: actual app interface visuals
sections.visual_direction: Static or near-static framing, clean background, screen as sole focal point.
sections.text_direction: Minimal or no on-screen text yet, reserve for later beats.
sections.speech_direction: None or a single short line hinting something is about to be built.
sections.pacing_direction: One shot, no cuts, slow enough to register the product clearly.
sections.transition_direction: Hard cut into the demonstration beat.
prohibited_elements: claims about what viewers will do

sections.section_purpose: Show the raw material: a reference video's structure being analyzed by the tool.
sections.content_instruction: Close-up on the screen as the tool breaks a sample reference video into its structural beats, visualized as simple timeline blocks.
required_information: to be supplied: UI treatment for structure breakdown
sections.visual_direction: Close, textured shot of the timeline/blocks animating into view.
sections.text_direction: Short on-screen label naming the step, e.g. structure identified (instructional cue only, not final copy).
sections.speech_direction: Brief explanatory line describing what is happening on screen.
sections.pacing_direction: One shot, single cut in from prior section, quick motion.
sections.transition_direction: Cut to the rebuilt output shot.
prohibited_elements: claims about what viewers will do

sections.section_purpose: Show the payoff: the same structure turned into the business's own finished draft, and prove it remains editable.
sections.content_instruction: Show the finished short video draft inside the editor, then a finger adjusting a clip, caption, or timing to demonstrate it can still be changed after generation.
required_information: to be supplied: actual editing controls available post-generation
sections.visual_direction: Same screen context as section 2 for continuity, now showing an edit action in progress.
sections.text_direction: On-screen label confirming the draft can be edited after it is built.
sections.speech_direction: One line stating the draft is ready and still adjustable.
sections.pacing_direction: One shot, single cut in, slightly faster than section 2 to signal progress.
sections.transition_direction: Cut to the closing human presence.
prohibited_elements: claims about what viewers will do

sections.section_purpose: Shift to a personal tone and prompt the viewer to try the tool on their next post.
sections.content_instruction: Cut to a warm, direct-to-camera moment of a small-business owner or founder figure speaking briefly and inviting the viewer to use the tool for their own next post.
required_information: to be supplied: who appears on camera (founder, customer, or brand representative)
sections.visual_direction: Medium close-up, natural setting, friendly expression, eye contact with camera.
sections.text_direction: Short closing on-screen prompt reinforcing the spoken invitation, confident but not boastful tone.
sections.speech_direction: Warm, brief direct address inviting trial, avoiding any guarantee or performance claim.
sections.pacing_direction: One shot, single cut in, settles into a steady pace for the close.
sections.cta_direction: Invite the viewer to try the tool for their next social post, phrased as a low-pressure personal invitation rather than a hard sell, with no price or outcome promises.
prohibited_elements: claims about what viewers will do
limitations: No specifics supplied about who the on-camera presenter is.

mandatory_point_accounting.text: show that the video stays editable after it is built
